shows: All six in their suits walk slowly toward camera in a line, guns upright on shoulders, in bright morning light; they barely advance, more of a walk-in-place stride.
faults: masks are small at this distance and triangles not readable; little forward progress (feels like walking on the spot)

place: marble bank lobby, doors smashed in
shows: CRIMSON in fedora strides in through shattered glass doors, gun pointed at the ceiling, the gang behind him; customers and a teller cower and crouch.
faults: gang members behind shuffle and swap places; an extra black-suited masked man appears at left later; mustard man's mask reads yellow-red

shows: A black sedan skids to a halt, knocking over fruit crates; MARINE in cream linen clings to the running board and nods, RUST driving inside.
faults: a crate flies across and vanishes; MARINE's pose and hands change jumpily; triangle not readable

place: rainy night street, police call box
shows: A policeman shouts into a call-box phone and waves his arm while a masked driver sits in a black roadster beside him in the rain, the butcher's shop glowing behind.
faults: driver's mask reads mustard with no clear ring or triangle; car drifts back and forth rather than driving off; readable shop sign 'BUTCHER'S SHOP' (real words, fine)

shows: All six stand round a small printing press under a red lamp, bouncing and gesturing, slapping the press, then throwing both hands up and pumping them at the lens.
faults: triangles inconsistent: missing on PLUM, sits on the wrong (left) side on some masks; extra raised hands pop in behind at the end

shows: BOTTLE in brown tweed leans on the bar and performs to the lens, chopping, shrugging and counting off fingers, while the barman behind waters down a bottle from a tin jug.
faults: triangle sits mid-face, slightly right, not clearly over the left eye; hand count off is four fingers not three

shows: CRIMSON in grey fedora sits at an old microphone and jabs and pumps his fists at the lens while a horned devil shadow looms on the wall behind him.
faults: none seen; shadow does not mirror his moves exactly and he drops his hands to the desk at the end

shows: BOTTLE in brown tweed pushes a wheelbarrow heaped with cash bundles out of a round vault; bundles drop to the floor.
faults: no red triangle visible on the mask; he stands upright and the barrow hardly moves in the second half; dropped bundles appear from nowhere

shows: MARINE in cream linen stands back to the wall on a high stone ledge, cash sack in hand, tiny cars crawling far below.
faults: triangle on the wrong side (left of picture); sack morphs size and shape at 1s

shows: PLUM in mustard pinstripe waves a big gloved hand at the lens like a stage magician while his other hand slips a banknote into his jacket.
All six on a cracked salt flat bounce, point and jab at the lens together, RUST nearest, with old hot rods and dust behind.
faults: RUST's triangle on the wrong side (left of picture); PLUM's and BOTTLE's triangles unclear

shows: Five of the gang bounce and point up at an overhead lens on a lantern-lit jetty while BOTTLE ties the speedboat's rope behind them.
faults: morphing: at about 1s and 4s heads twist and masks turn sideways or lose their ring (CRIMSON's mask goes dark); men swap places
